SELECT profile_id , profile_name , profile_desc , NVL(use_flag,'Y') AS use_flag FROM LGCOM_PROFILE_M pm WHERE 1 = 1
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM LGCOM_PROFILE_TARGET_SETUP_N WHERE profile_id = pm.profile_id AND profile_apply_tg_class_code = #{profileScopeCode})
AND profile_name LIKE '%' || #{profileName} || '%'
AND profile_desc LIKE '%' || #{profileDesc} || '%'
AND use_flag = #{useFlag}
ORDER BY profile_name

SELECT a.profile_id , a.data_serial_no , a.profile_apply_tg_class_code , a.apply_target_value , DECODE(a.profile_apply_tg_class_code, 'SITE',a.apply_target_value, 'SYSTEM',b.system_name, 'USER',(SELECT NVL(full_name_local,english_full_name) FROM LGCOM_USER_M_V WHERE application_user_id = a.apply_target_value)) AS apply_target_name , a.profile_option_value , a.use_flag FROM ( SELECT pts.profile_id , pts.data_serial_no , pts.profile_apply_tg_class_code , pts.apply_target_value , pts.profile_option_value , pts.use_flag , code.sort_order_no FROM ( SELECT common_code, sort_order_no FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_PROFILE_CLASS_CODE' AND use_flag = 'Y' AND (apply_start_date IS NULL OR apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (apply_end_date IS NULL OR apply_end_date >= SYSDATE) ) code , LGCOM_PROFILE_TARGET_SETUP_N pts WHERE code.common_code = pts.profile_apply_tg_class_code ) a -- System , ( SELECT lcc.common_code AS system_code , lccm.common_code_name AS system_name FROM LGCOM_CODE_TYPE_CODE_C lct , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C lcc , LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_MULTI_LANG_C lccm WHERE lct.code_type_code = lcc.code_type_code AND lct.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.common_code = lccm.common_code AND lcc.company_id = lccm.company_id AND lcc.inventory_organization_id = lccm.inventory_organization_id AND lcc.code_type_code = lccm.code_type_code AND lcc.use_flag = 'Y' AND lccm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND lcc.code_type_code = 'LGCOM_SYSTEM_CODE' AND (lcc.apply_start_date IS NULL OR lcc.apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (lcc.apply_end_date IS NULL OR lcc.apply_end_date >= SYSDATE) ) b WHERE a.profile_id = #{profileId} AND a.apply_target_value = b.system_code(+) ORDER BY a.sort_order_no,a.profile_id,a.data_serial_no
